questions.stem: How are root hair cells adapted to maximise the absorption of water and minerals?

options.text: They have thick cell walls to withstand soil pressure
They have a long, thin extension that increases their surface area
They contain chloroplasts to produce energy for absorption
They have no cell membrane to allow free movement of substances

questions.explanation: Root hair cells have a long, thin hair-like extension that greatly increases the surface area in contact with the soil. This allows more water and mineral ions to be absorbed efficiently.
